title: My Jesus, as Thou Wilt
description: My Jesus, as Thou Wilt in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Benjamin Schmolck, first published in 1704. The English translation is by Jane Laurie Borthwick (1854). The tune, JEWETT, is by Carl Maria Friedrich Ernst von Weber (1821). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: My Je-sus,_ as Thou_ wilt! Oh, may Thy_ will be mine! In-to Thy_ hand of love I_ would_ my all_ re-sign;_ Through sor-row,_ or through_ joy, con-duct me_ as Thine own, And help me_ still to say, my_ Lord, Thy will be done!

lines: Oh, may Thy will be mine!
And help me still to say,
my Lord, Thy will be done!
And if all else should fail,
my Lord, thy will be done!
Let not my star of hope
Since Thou on earth hast wept,
If I must weep with Thee,
my Lord, Thy will be done!
All shall be well for me;
And sing, in life or death,
my Lord, Thy will be done!
